scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: The best salespeople don't start by talking about the product when they open their mouths. Do you know why?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Because the average time a customer listens to you speak is only 3 seconds.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Even shorter than the time it takes to cook instant noodles.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: You spent two whole hours traveling to see a customer, but the very first sentence you say is, 'Our company has a great promotion recently...' The customer's brain has already classified you as an advertisement and automatically skipped you.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Why? Because people only stop for products related to themselves. So the opening hook shouldn't be about the product, but about what the customer is currently thinking.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: I'll give you a formula: Opening Hook equals a user-related pain point plus a surprising data point or story. For example, if you sell insurance, instead of showing off the product, try saying it like this...

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Last month, there was a small business owner just like you who almost had his company shut down for 3 months because of an unexpected accident. He later told me something very profound...

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: When you say it this way, the customer will definitely ask, 'What did he say?' This way, you're not selling; you're initiating a dialogue.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Copy makes people understand instantly, voice makes people moved, and action makes people act. And the starting point for all of this is the first 3 seconds.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: I'm the speaker. Helping you understand human nature and close high-value deals. Leave a comment with the words 'Opening Hook' and I'll send you an Opening Hook Formula Card.
